findings.mechanism: An actual private Research run failed because the historical checker could not recognize the reviewed profile-driven build selector. A newly explicit profile hash also exposes CRLF conversion in an existing Windows checkout. These are connected selector-binding integration defects, not mathematical failures.
findings.scope_reason: The old regex assumed that the active builder selected the V14 manuscript named by the historical audit record. The reviewed profile-driven builder selects V16 instead. The explicit binding joins the actual reviewed builder and profile to their selected TeX without treating historical V14 approvals as current V16 acceptance. The -text rule and unchanged LF profile refresh are needed so exact profile hashing works on Windows as well as Git-blob input. Search includes the caller, retained historical checks, new selector checks, negative controls, original failure and independent exact repair review.
